reason: The README describes a DSH integration shim that conditionally adapts Codex-style prompts, tools, planning, search, file operations, and WebUI presentation for selected model routes while relying on existing DSH providers.

summaries.zh: 该插件为选定的模型路由提供 Codex 风格的提示词、工具适配、计划管理、搜索和 WebUI 展示，并复用 DSH 现有能力。
summaries.en: This plugin adapts prompts, tools, planning, search, and WebUI presentation to a Codex-style interface for selected model routes using existing DSH capabilities.

capabilities: Adapts prompts, tool vocabulary, tool results, and WebUI presentation for selected model routes
Runs shell commands through existing DSH shell capabilities
Applies file patches including add, delete, update, and move operations
Reads supported image files when filesystem and attachment capabilities are available
Performs search-only web queries through the existing DSH web capability
Stores and updates plan steps through durable session events
Masks overlapping host tools from active prompt advertisements on matching routes
